summary_1line: Arjuna battles a mysterious Kirata—actually Shiva—until defeated, then realizes the truth and worships him, earning Shiva’s favor and promise of a divine weapon.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna and the giant Kirata grapple chest to chest in the mountains, their bodies smoking from the force of their blows.
Arjuna offers a garland to a clay image of Shiva, only to see the same garland suddenly appear upon the crown of the Kirata hunter.
Shiva reveals his radiant form beside Uma on the mountain, while the wounded Arjuna kneels in reverence before him.
